__comment: OAuth 1.0a (HMAC-SHA1) replaces any username/password validator. customUI hosts the consent webview (like com.palm.eas / com.palm.skype); getAuthorizeUrl runs OAuth leg 1 (getRequestToken) and returns the authorize URL + request token/secret, Atlas captures oauth_verifier from the redirect to Config.CALLBACK_URL, then exchangeCode runs leg 3 (getAccessToken) and returns the stored token credentials. SmugMug is a PHOTO source only - no DOCUMENTS capability, no files app.
__comment2: com.palm.app.smugmug-auth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs under the customUI auth app's identity and is permission-checked against these lists (accounts/handlers/create.js -> Utils.hasPermission). Working templates (teams/telegram/skype/dropbox) list their own auth app, not com.palm.app.accounts.
__comment3: com.palm.service.smugmug is in read+writePermissions so the service itself can readCredentials(accountId) to sign photo-provider calls. SmugMug OAuth 1.0a tokens do NOT expire/rotate, so writeCredentials is effectively unused after create (kept for symmetry).

capabilityProviders.__comment: Makes the SmugMug account a photo source. implementation/hooks point at the stock Photos AGGREGATOR (com.palm.service.photos), which discovers PHOTO.UPLOAD accounts and (its service name derived from the templateId) calls com.palm.service.smugmug/listAlbums+listPhotos and downloads each photo from the URL listPhotos gives.
